title: Reservation ops: intake, approvals, and capacity planning for Dedicated pools
creator: Leah Chen
description:
Summary: Define and ship a robust reservation intake and approval workflow for Dedicated capacity purchases and reservations. This ticket captures the product requirements, approval matrix, capacity planner handoff, and the UI/Console flow for submitting and tracking reservation requests.

Problem: Enterprise customers buying Dedicated capacity need a predictable, auditable way to request reserved GPU pools, get approvals from finance/security, and work with capacity planners to schedule start dates and burst policies. Current process is ad-hoc (email + spreadsheet) and causes delays for formal procurement, incorrect sizing, and missed billing commitments.

Goals:
- Provide a standard reservation request form in Console and a lightweight API endpoint for SRE/sales to create requests programmatically.
- Implement an approval matrix (Finance, Security, Sales Ops) with configurable SLAs per team.
- Integrate a capacity planner handoff that produces a recommended GPU mix, expected throughput guarantees, and pricing estimates.
- Make approvals auditable and surfaced in Console (status, approver, comments), and generate an official reservation PDF/contract snapshot for legal.
- Emit events to billing, infra scheduling, and account teams so provisioning work can begin once approved.

Acceptance criteria:
- Console: "New Reservation" form capturing: requested throughput (rps, tokens/s), target regions, desired start date, commitment length, expected max burst, customer contact, and billing PO number.
- Approval workflow implemented with at least 3 approver roles; approver groups can be mapped to SSO groups. Approver comments and decisions are versioned and visible.
- Capacity planner output: recommended reserved GPU count, model family mapping, expected steady-state latency SLO coverage, and cost estimate. Output stored as a CSV/Drive link and a snapshot in Console.
- On approval, system emits a reservation_approved event to internal pubsub with reservation_id, start_date, recommended_pool_spec, and accounting_tags.
- Reservation list view in Console with filters (status, customer, region, start date) and export to CSV.
- End-to-end tests for form validation, approval transitions, event emission, and billing integration (mock).

Out of scope for this ticket:
- Automated physical provisioning in private clusters (follow-up ticket with ENG-2041).
- Price negotiation UI for sales-led custom pricing (handled in separate PM flow).
